decision_conditions:
The
development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three
years from the date of planning permission P/4120/22 dated 04/07/2024.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference P/4120/22 dated 04/07/2024. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: BA316/01 Rev A, BA316/10 Rev A, BA316/12 Rev A, BA316/18 Rev A, BA316/28 Rev G, BA316/29 Rev C, BA316/31 Rev B, Minor Material Amendments Application, Part 1 of 2; Minor Material Amendments Application, Part 2 of 2; 567-AND-D2-V3-00-DR-A-1020 rev A; 567-AND-D2-V3-B1-DR-A-1021 rev H; 567-AND-D2-V3-GF-DR-A-1022 rev G; 567-AND-D2-V3-01-DR-A-1023 rev C; 567-AND-D2-V3-02-DR-A-1024 rev B; 567-AND-D2-V3-RF-DR-A-1025 rev B; 567-AND-D2-V3-ZZ-DR-A-2021 Rev E; 567-AND-D2-V3-ZZ-DR-A-3021 Rev F.

<p>The development hereby approved shall not progress beyond Damp Proof Course until a Fire Safety Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point&nbsp;</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in&nbsp;</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p>The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the first floor windows on the flank elevations have been fitted with obscured glazing, and no part of those windows that are less than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which it is installed shall be capable of being opened. Details of the type of obscured glazing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the window is installed and once installed the obscured glazing shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Development shall not commence, other than demolition works, until drainage works for the development shall have been carried out in accordance with details which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Development shall not commence, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Plan shall provide for:</p><p><br></p><p>a) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;</p><p>b) construction vehicle numbers, type, routing;</p><p>c) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;</p><p>d) programme of work and phasing;</p><p>e) layout plan, including access arrangements to the site;</p><p>f) highway conditions (before, during and after);</p><p>g) Traffic Management requirements.</p><p><br></p><p>The approved Construction Method Statement shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The approved waste storage areas shall be provided, and made available for use, on site prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and retained as such thereafter. Refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the approved refuse storage areas.</p>

<p>Development shall not commence, other than demolition works, until works for the disposal of surface water and works for surface water attenuation and storage shall have been carried out in accordance with details which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and the details approved in Condition 6, prior to the first occupation of proposed development hereby approved, full details of the hard and soft landscaping features of the front lightwells shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include: a) Planting plans and schedules of plants, noting species, plant species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities;&nbsp;</p><p><span style="white-space: pre; white-space: normal;">	</span></p><p>The landscaping works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details before any part of the development is first occupied in accordance with the agreed implementation programme.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details approved under PL/0008/25 dated 11/04/2025 or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details approved in Condition 8, prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works, full details of the external railings for the proposed access to the front entrance of the proposed development hereby approved shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details of external surfaces approved under PL/0008/25 dated 11/04/2025 or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter.</p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/4120/22 allowed on appeal reference APP/M5450/W/23/3327142 dated 04/07/2024 to allow addition of two lightwells; additional bedrooms to flats one and two; internal alterations
